question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"grammar."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Grammar" **refers to the rules and principles that govern the use of language, including syntax, punctuation, and spelling. (भाषा में शब्‍दरचना और वाक्‍यरचना के नियम; व्‍याकरण)
 
• In this context, filling in the blank with** "grammar" **would indicate that the missing word relates to language structure or mechanics.
 
 
• **Example**:* Russian **grammar**__ can be difficult for foreign learners.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

Today, I want to talk to you about a very simple matter, that is, simple conversations. When we learn to speak, __first__ come words, then phrases, and then scripts. You would agree that the larger the bundles of words we __carry around__, the less we have to worry about combining them into sensible __expressions__. Also the less we have to fret over syntax or __**grammar**__. Do you think you choose the words? Do you pre-rehearse every time you go out? ______ (5) ______ what happens when you walk into a fast-food restaurant. My dear, how do you react in those real life situations?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Dictates"** can also refer to the act of speaking or recording words, or to the principles that guide behavior or decision-making. (शब्दों को बोलने या रिकॉर्ड करने की क्रिया, या ऐसे सिद्धांत जो व्यवहार या निर्णय लेने का मार्गदर्शन करते हैं)
 
• **"Hyperbole" and "exaggeration"** both refer to the act of overstating or embellishing something, often for effect or emphasis. (अक्सर प्रभाव या जोर देने के लिए किसी चीज़ को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर या अलंकृत करने की क्रिया)
